summary: V26.n Home callback row tap behavior — all 5 items verified end-to-end via Playwright + backend seeding. Row Pressable now routes to /contact/{contact_id} when contact_id is truthy, and fires a native alert 'Nessun contatto collegato' otherwise (no navigation). Pencil icon (callback-edit-{id}) correctly opens /callback/{id} with prefilled 'Modifica ritelefonata' form. Toggle checkmark (callback-toggle-{id}) toggles done via PUT /api/callbacks/{id} without navigation. Contact detail Info tab shows phone number + Chiama button that opens CallActionSheet (visually confirmed with 'Chiama ora' + 'Salta e registra solo l'esito').

test_scenarios_executed.desc: No alert dialog fires when contact_id present
Contact detail Info tab shows phone (+393331234567)
comm-call button present in contact Info tab
Chiama button opens CallActionSheet (Chiamata / Chiama ora / Salta e registra solo l'esito)
Tap callback-open-{id} WITHOUT contact_id → URL unchanged (stays on /home)
Native alert with message 'Nessun contatto collegato a questa ritelefonata.' captured via page.on('dialog')
Edit form prefilled with callback title
Row body tap (with contact) goes to /contact/{id} NOT /callback/{id}

critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx CallbackRow (lines 274-315) has clean separation: 3 sibling Pressables — callback-open-{id}, callback-edit-{id}, callback-toggle-{id}. Good use of hitSlop=8 on edit/toggle for 44px effective touch target despite compact icon size.
onOpen handler (lines 197-208) correctly branches web vs native (window.alert vs Alert.alert) — both paths tested.
seed_data_creation: Created via API during test: 1 contact (TESTRitel Contact, phone +393331234567), 2 callbacks (one WITH contact_id + one WITHOUT). All cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V26.n Home callback row behavior is complete and stable. Row tap → contact detail (or alert if no contact). Pencil icon → edit route. Checkmark → toggle done. Dialog handler in Playwright must be registered BEFORE the click via page.on('dialog', ...); tested at 390x844 mobile viewport.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
